title: Vectors: Chat test cases
notes: Extended canonical Compact CoT chat corpus to 9 positive and 7 negative vectors. Positive coverage includes broadcast/team/direct, Team 0x01 and 0x0A endpoints, full 16-byte direct native IPv6 addresses including high 0x02-prefix endpoint, empty text, 9-byte multibyte UTF-8, and the 255-byte maximum. Negative coverage includes unknown tag, team 0/0x0B, truncated direct ID/message, trailing byte, and invalid UTF-8. Python core/gateway and Rust consume all relevant vectors byte-exactly; Python/Rust now reject invalid UTF-8 at construction/decode. Green: Python Compact CoT suites 164, ruff (inherited gateway-test E402 ignored only), mypy, schema; Rust canonical vectors 3, focused lib 20, rustfmt, no_std check, clippy -D warnings. No codereview/commit/push.
